status: PROPOSED ONLY — NOT IMPLEMENTED OR AUTHORIZED
purpose: Reusable controlled Teaching Agent lesson domain/runtime integration tests against an explicitly approved development DB; not a Student admission path

principals.humanOperator: Authenticated Platform Owner authorizes provisioning/run; never used as the learner data principal
principals.executionSubject: Dedicated non-human development test principal, unique per run/scenario; never a real user or personal account
principals.storageReality: Existing attempts/progress require auth.users FK; a random UUID or process-only actor cannot satisfy current schema
principals.recommendedRepresentation: Provision a dedicated non-login Auth principal only via a separately authorized official Admin provisioning lifecycle; retain existing Activity/Attempt/Progress tables
principals.tenant: Dedicated development test tenant with explicit non-personal namespace; never select arbitrary existing tenant/user
principals.credentials: No browser login, no impersonation token, no magic link, no teaching-student session; principal must be sign-in disabled before run scope becomes active. Provisioning API no-login/ban behavior must be verified before approval; failure => STOP

identityRegistry.source: Server-controlled persistent test-run registry/receipt outside client/public manifest, plus admin-controlled Auth app_metadata test marker; user_metadata/email prefix alone is never authorization
identityRegistry.ids: Actual resource references stay private server-side; public evidence stores opaque safe resource hashes only
identityRegistry.durability: Registry survives isolated service restart to resolve exact same test subject; authoritative completion remains in existing DB attempts/progress, never registry

gates: deployment role must be explicitly isolated development execution; production service composition never imports or enables this issuer
pinned approved development project/database identity and fixed target binding; no arbitrary connection/actor/tenant/content ID from request
existing normal Platform Owner authorization at run issuance; operator action is audited separately from execution subject
server registry + admin-owned metadata + verified non-login status + tenant scope + expiry must all match
bounded scenario operation budget and exact activity/snapshot/generation/request correlation; no generic SQL/grade/target endpoint
authorization.roleSeparation: Backend may call existing service-only atomic domain RPC only after test-scope authorization. It never creates a user session or represents an actual student. This new test authorization is proposed and needs approval; service privileges alone are insufficient.
authorization.StudentPolicy: Unchanged; real Student endpoints keep published-only checks. Test scope is rejected by production admission and Agent/tool registries.
authorization.agentFeature: OFF; unrelated to proposed test-only gate

runScope.publicFacts: Safe completion/attempt summary, source and observed freshness only; no actual subject ID, raw answer, private key or definition digest
runScope.scenarios: Separate owned test subjects per independent scenario when needed; reuse same subject across restart/readback for that scenario; enumerate exact count before writes

lifecycle: PROPOSED -> APPROVED -> PROVISIONING -> VERIFIED_NONLOGIN -> ACTIVE -> CLOSED -> RETAINED_DISABLED or CLEANED
Provision via official auth/tenant APIs only after enumerating trigger-generated profiles, memberships and audits; no raw auth.users INSERT
UNKNOWN provision result stops and reconciles by server-owned run marker through read-only inspection; never blind-create duplicates
Run only approved domain actions; wrong/correct attempt via existing grader + R7C transaction seam; independent readback drives media resume
Close stops future mutation grants while allowing bounded approved verification
Cleanup first enumerates all inbound references across existing schema; deletes only approved run-owned attempt/progress children in dependency order; never canonical authoring rows; no CASCADE
If Auth deletion API would cascade unapproved records or audit retention requires principal references, do not delete; retain principal disabled and registry closed with exact residual references

provisioningImpact.migration: Not proposed; existing schema can represent identity FKs. If lifecycle cannot safely fit existing schema, STOP with separate minimal proposal
